title: BUG: C_DestroyObject calls wp11_soft_key_free on flash keys
description: C_DestroyObject (src/wp11_pkcs11.c ~line 1820) calls wp11_soft_key_free(obj->key_priv) without checking obj->is_flash_key. For a flash key, key_priv points into keystore memory owned by wp11_keystore_t — not a separately heap-allocated wp11_soft_key_t. Calling wp11_soft_key_free on it is a type confusion and heap corruption, followed by a double-free when C_Logout/C_Finalize calls wp11_keystore_free. Trigger: any conformant PKCS#11 application calling C_DestroyObject on a key handle returned from C_FindObjects on a flash slot after C_Login. Fix: add the same is_flash_key guard that exists in C_Finalize (lines 1161-1163) to C_DestroyObject. The inline doc to add: a block comment at the wp11_key_obj_t struct listing every call site that must check is_flash_key before touching key_priv.
